newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Lordos Hotels 1996 first half loss.
newsitem.headline: Lordos Hotels 1996 first half loss.

text.p: Results in first half to June 30, 1996
NOTE: Full company name is Lordos Hotels (Holdings) Ltd.

The results have not been checked by external auditors. The company and its board of directors had not prepared six monthly results for 1995 and the comparative figures shown are based on estimates calculated from final audited accounts of the 1995 financial year.
Turnover does not include deals between companies of the group.

Extraordinary loss relates to the settlement of a demand for compensation raised by owners of the 'Evzonas Hill Hotel Apartments' because of the premature termination of the administration contract by the company. Payment of the sum also settles the counter-demand of the company to apartment owners for the non-payment of their own obligations stemming from the contract.

Taxation for 1996 includes the sum of 98,735 Cyprus pounds which represents additional capital gains tax of 69,330, plus 36,977 in interest, from the sale of a hotel of subsidiary Arnalda Developments Ltd in 1990.

Unfavourable circumstances having a negative effect on the tourist industry continued this year. In view of these developments the results of the first half of the year are considered satisfactory and it is expected that the results for the entire financial year will show a small improvement against those of 1995. It is expected that the implementation of a programme to restructure the group will bring about a further improvement to results in future, the company said.
